extracted.name: Snickerdoodles
ingredient_lines: 3/4 cup castor sugar or granulated sugar
2 tablespoons castor sugar or granulated sugar
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius
Grease a baking sheet or aluminum foil on a baking tray
Cream the butter and sugar together until creamy. Add in the vanilla extract and egg, and beat until combined.
Sift together the flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Beat and combine until a soft cookie dough forms.
Chill the dough for around 20-30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, stir together the cinnamon and sugar.
Roll the cookie dough into 1 inch balls and roll it into the cinnamon sugar. Place them 2 inches apart on a baking sheet.
Bake for 10-11 minutes. Allow the cookies to cool on the tray for 5-10 minutes before removing and transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
